{{Quote|When now we visit the Memorial to the Missing of Ghorman, the Graveyard at Alderaan, the Wroshyr Mural on Kashyyyk, or the Hall of the Unknown on Chandrila, among others, we must reflect upon the fact that so vast was the system of Imperial genocide that we may never know anything about the majority of those we lost except for the fact that they died.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
The '''Memorial to the Missing of Ghorman''' was a memorial to those [[Death|killed]] on<ref name="Rise" /> the [[Colonies]]<ref name="Galaxy Map">{{GalaxyMapPoster}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Ghorman system]]</ref> [[planet]]<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> [[Ghorman]] by the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]], which included the [[Ghorman Massacre]] in [[2 BBY]].<ref name="Rise" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="RiseDate">{{RiseAndFallDate}}</ref> the [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] mentioned the memorial alongside similar structures in<ref name="Rise" /> his<ref name="TROSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'', reminding readers that so many died under the Empire that no information remained on many of the victims.<ref name="Rise" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Memorial to the Missing of Ghorman was mentioned in the [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'', which was written by Dr. [[Chris Kempshall]].<ref name="Rise" />
